public_task_requirement: Please implement a website for a credit repair company to generate leads. The website should have a form-filling function, allowing users to input personal information and credit status. The website should also have a credit score inquiry function and an introduction to credit repair services. Users can browse the website, learn about credit repair services, and fill out the form to submit lead information. Set old lace as the body background and use rosy brown for the UI.

task_summary.requirement_coverage: The site targeted a credit repair lead-generation landing page with three core user-facing capabilities: a form for personal/credit-status lead capture, a credit score inquiry action, and an introduction to credit repair services, all styled with an old lace body background and rosy brown UI. Verified strengths: the credit score inquiry flow was observed to work and display a score/feedback; the color palette was judged to match the requested scheme; the page rendered without visible runtime errors. Main functional risks: the lead form was not confirmed as submitted before interaction budget exhaustion, so the confirmation state was not reached; the services/introduction content was not fully verified and was reported as not found in the interaction trace; navigation/content visibility depended on switching views, which limited what was actually reachable within the budget. Visible observations: the landing page showed navigation buttons and a credit score CTA, while the evaluator noted low text contrast and that the form and detailed service introduction were not clearly visible on the first screen.
verified_strengths: Credit score inquiry button produced a visible score result and qualitative feedback in the interaction trace.
The requested old lace background and rosy brown UI styling were observed as matching the specification.
The page rendered cleanly with no visible errors in the screenshot-based evaluation.
primary_functional_risks: Form submission was not completed before the interaction limit, so lead capture confirmation remained unverified.
The credit repair services introduction was not confirmed in the interaction trace and may not have been visible in the evaluated state.
Some content depended on view switching/scrolling, increasing the chance that required information was not reachable within the limited evaluation path.
primary_visual_observations: The landing page showed a simple navigation row and a prominent credit score CTA.
The evaluator reported low contrast between the heading text and the light background.
The screenshot-based review noted that the form-filling function and detailed services introduction were not clearly visible on the first screen.

appearance_reflection.observed_result: The home view renders the heading "Welcome to Credit Repair Experts" inside a section whose cards use white backgrounds, while the app container uses "oldlace" and the nav and buttons use "rosybrown". The reviewer reported that the heading text has very low contrast against the background and that the typography is minimal, with readability needing better font weight or contrast.
appearance_reflection.likely_cause_or_limitation: The code shows the page is built with the specified colors, but the first-screen heading styling does not provide enough visible contrast for the reviewer’s screenshot. This is an appearance issue about what must be readable up front, not a missing feature.
appearance_reflection.preventative_action: Make the main heading and any hero text pass a clear contrast check against the page background, and give the primary heading a visibly stronger weight or size so it reads easily on the first screen. Verify by rendering the landing view and confirming the top headline is legible without relying on hover or scrolling.
appearance_reflection.verification: Open the landing page and check that the main headline is readable at a glance against the background, with stronger weight or contrast than surrounding text.
appearance_reflection.transfer_limits: Applies to landing pages and hero sections that use large headline text over a colored background.
